article.content_html:
Background of the Incident

Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir posted a video that has drawn attention and criticism. The video shows the minister with pro-Palestinian activists who are handcuffed and kneeling on a ship.

Reaction from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has rebuked Minister Ben-Gvir for his actions in the video. The prime minister's response indicates a level of disapproval within the government regarding the minister's behavior.

Implications of the Incident

The incident may have implications for the relationship between Israel and pro-Palestinian groups. The video has sparked controversy and may lead to further tensions between the parties involved.

Possible Next Steps

While the details of any next steps are not available, the incident is likely to be closely watched by various stakeholders. The reaction from Prime Minister Netanyahu suggests that there may be internal discussions within the government regarding the minister's actions.
